business_problem: FAB sought to scale AI across core banking processes and client offerings, while enabling relationship managers and other teams to make decisions, serve customers, and work more efficiently.
solution_summary: First Abu Dhabi Bank established an AI Innovation Hub as a connected standalone unit to scale AI in banking and client offerings. The Hub's data foundation is a robust platform built by FAB's IT team; the source does not identify its products or describe source-system ingestion, storage design, or model-serving components. Bain developed a strategic roadmap and is implementing a build-operate-transfer model, while Microsoft is the primary technology partner, providing cloud infrastructure, data platforms, engineering, generative AI, and agentic capabilities. FAB, Bain, and Microsoft work as an integrated strategy-to-execution team; the platform supports agentic use cases, including relationship-manager tools for investment advice, asset/liability recommendations, and account planning. Governance, qualification, enforcement, and regulatory compliance are built into the Hub's design. The page reports more than 20 implemented use cases and 20 more in development.
business_outcome: FAB reports that AI is driving measurable impact in performance, efficiency, and customer experience across the Group. More than 20 agentic AI use cases have been implemented, with 20 more in development.
metrics: more than 20 agentic AI use cases have been implemented
